title: Muammoni aytish va sharh yozish
can_do: Muammoni odob bilan tushuntirasiz va mehmonxona haqida sharh yozasiz
why: Xonadagi nosozlik haqida aytish kerak bo'ladi — va bu jahl bilan emas, odob bilan aytiladi. Bu dars o'sha iboralar va sharh yozish tartibini beradi.

points.text: Muammo yumshoq boshlanadi: Excuse me, there's a problem with … Bu «Give me another room!» kabi buyruqdan farq qiladi — xodim sizga yordam berishi uchun odob kerak.

examples.en: Excuse me, there's a problem with the air conditioning.

points.text: Nosozlikni aytishning tayyor shakli: it doesn't work, it is broken. «It is not working good» emas — good sifat, bu yerda ravish yoki umuman kerak emas.
Iltimos bilan tugatiladi: Could I have another room? Could you send someone to fix it?

examples.en: Could I have another room, please?
Could you send someone to fix it?

points.text: Sharh (review) uch qismdan yoziladi: baho — nima yaxshi va nima yomon, sabab — nega shunday, tavsiya — boshqalarga maslahat.

examples.en: The rooms are clean and the staff is friendly. But the Wi-Fi doesn't work. I recommend this hotel for one night.
examples.uz: Xonalar toza, xodimlar xushmuomala. Lekin Wi-Fi ishlamaydi. Bir kecha uchun bu mehmonxonani tavsiya qilaman.

head: Vaziyat
Iborasi
rows: Excuse me, there's a problem with …
It doesn't work. / It is broken.
I recommend this hotel. / I don't recommend it.

common_errors.wrong: The TV is not working good.
common_errors.why: Good sifat, fe'lni tasvirlash uchun u kelmaydi. Oddiy shakl: doesn't work.

common_errors.right: Could I have another room, please?
common_errors.why: «Give me» buyruq bo'lib eshitiladi. Iltimos Could I have bilan boshlanadi.

common_errors.wrong: I have a problem with the air conditioner is broken.
common_errors.right: There's a problem with the air conditioner: it is broken.
common_errors.why: Ikki konstruksiya bitta gapga sig'maydi — alohida aytiladi.

common_errors.right: It was a very bad hotel.
common_errors.why: Birlik ot oldidan artikl tushib qolmasligi kerak.

common_errors.wrong: The room was dirty and I am very angry!!!
common_errors.right: The room was dirty, so I asked for another one.
common_errors.why: Sharh fakt bilan yoziladi, his bilan emas. Shikoyatda ham xotirjam ohang kerak.

words.example: There's a problem with the shower.
The street is very noisy at night.
I wrote a review about the hotel.

practice_spec.note: Mashqlarni AI shu spetsifikatsiya bo'yicha yaratadi. Tur raqamlari — docs/mashqlar.md dagi shkala.

items.focus: vaziyatga qarab shikoyat gapini tuzish: sovuq suv, shovqin, ishlamaydigan lift
administrator bilan dialog va beshta gapdan iborat sharh

final.task: Mehmonxona haqida sharh yozing: ikkita yaxshi tomon, bitta muammo va tavsiya. 6 gap.

skill_task.task: Unit 6 ni takrorlang: there is / are va each / all the bilan beshta gap tuzing. Keyin beshta xatoli gap yozing va xatoni tushuntiring.
